name: channelpilot-mvp
description: AI copilot for YouTube and YouTube Studio

scripts.build: npm run build -w @channelpilot/shared && npm run build -w @channelpilot/extension && npm run build -w @channelpilot/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @channelpilot/shared && npm run dev -w @channelpilot/api
scripts.dev:extension: npm run build -w @channelpilot/shared && npm run dev -w @channelpilot/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @channelpilot/shared && npm run build -w @channelpilot/shared && npm run typecheck -w @channelpilot/extension && npm run typecheck -w @channelpilot/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @channelpilot/shared && npm run test -w @channelpilot/api && npm run test:extension && npm run test:ui -w @channelpilot/extension
scripts.test:browser-bridge: npm run build -w @channelpilot/shared && npm run build -w @channelpilot/extension && node apps/extension/test/browser-media-bridge.smoke.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
